note: Chad: nationals of the countries and territories listed by Chad's Directorate of Emigration and Immigration or by Timatic enter without a visa for 90 days (the two lists differ, and several exemptions were cancelled and resumed in 2024 to 2026: taken as the article lists them); everyone else needs an e-Visa or a visa beforehand (taken as an e-Visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Chad
sources.said: Visitors to Chad must obtain either an electronic visa online or a regular visa in advance, unless if they are a national of one of the visa-exempt countries. ... nationals of the following countries and territories may enter Chad without a visa for the period listed below: 90 days Barbados Benin Bermuda Burkina Faso Cameroon Central African Republic Congo Republic Cook Islands Côte d'Ivoire Dominica Equatorial Guinea Gabon Mali Micronesia Mauritania Niger Nigeria Rwanda Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Senegal Singapore Suriname Togo United Arab Emirates ... 1 — Not listed by Timatic as being visa-exempt. 2 — Not listed by the Directorate of Emigration and Immigration of Chad as being visa-exempt.
